references.text: The hand of the witnesses shall be the first to put him to death, and afterward the hand of all the people. The same principle that the witnesses must cast the first stone.
Those who heard the blasphemy were to lay their hands on his head, and the whole congregation was to stone him. A similar procedure for execution by stoning.
Jesus said: Let he who is without sin among you be the first to throw a stone at her. Reference to the practice that someone must cast the first stone.
The witnesses laid their clothes at the feet of a young man named Saul, and began to stone Stephen. The witnesses took the initiative for the stoning.
You shall bring out to the gate of the city the man or woman who has done this evil deed, and you shall stone them to death. The same penalty for idolatry.
